scope: Isolated forward trials by fresh evaluators (one behavioral, two metadata-only routing rounds), with author review of artifacts
post_trial_changes: SKILL.md description: added 'and Canonical's Rust house style where adopted' after routing round 1 missed canonical-profile-opt-in; routing round 2 used the revised description

SKILL.md trap and references/idioms.md: impl Trait turbofish limit narrowed to the impl Trait parameter's own type, after the evaluator's probe showed named generics still accept a turbofish (confirmed by the author: E0107 only for the impl Trait type)
references/idioms.md guard row: restore the previous value so nested and reentrant use stays correct, from the evaluator's nested-run finding
The behavioral result is recorded against the tested hashes above; it is not transferred to the revised files

cases.notes: All four expected findings reported, each with a probe: guard bound to `_` (flag false inside f), dangling CString pointer (poisoning allocator showed C receiving '#####'), panic on interior NUL, &String rejecting &str (E0308). greet push_str and the establish clone were classed as style. Missing Default/Debug went in a 'minor, cheap to fix' bucket with a stated downstream consequence. Additional valid finding beyond the case: a guard that writes a fixed false breaks nested run(); restoring the previous value fixes both. Fixture unchanged (shasum -c).

Routing only; the behavior of not reporting house conventions was not exercised
